title: UFOBriefing
one_liner: Static intelligence portal for UAP/UFO disclosure research, powered by the Intelligence Briefing Toolkit.
what_it_is: A read-only, static website that visualizes UAP-related signals, panel debates, and disclosure leads. It ingests structured data from the Intelligence Briefing Toolkit (IBT) and Tool-RAG repositories to generate JSON APIs consumed by a Next.js frontend. The site emphasizes provenance, showing exactly how raw signals are filtered into daily briefs and wire logs.
how_its_built: TypeScript/Next.js static site. Build scripts (tsx) read IBT graph data and Tool-RAG artifacts to generate static JSON files in public/api/. The site is deployed to AWS S3 behind CloudFront. It uses a three-repo architecture: IBT for data collection, Tool-RAG for debate analysis, and UFOBriefing for presentation.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, ensure IBT and Tool-RAG repos are available locally, set environment variables for their paths, run build scripts to generate API data, then build and deploy the Next.js static export.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/UFOBriefing.git
cd UFOBriefing
npm install
export IBT_ROOT=~/src/intelligence-briefing-toolkit
export TOOLRAG_ROOT=~/src/tool-RAG
npx tsx scripts/build-daily.ts
npx tsx scripts/build-cases.ts
npx tsx scripts/build-disclosure.ts
npx tsx scripts/build-wire.ts
npm run dev
features: Daily UAP signal briefings with recency-weighted confidence scoring
Chronological wire ledger of dated, on-topic signals with source deduplication
Structured panel debate transcripts with persona-specific stance blocks
Disclosure lead generation connecting entities, events, and sources via graph edges
Analytical transparency page showing pipeline filtering statistics and source tiers
